versions.changelog:
Initial release of requirement-processor — a structured workflow for processing user requirements.

- Provides a step-by-step process: clarify, survey, document, validate, plan, and iterate.
- Includes a comprehensive requirements document template (requirements.md) for standardizing analysis and planning.
- Guides users on asking clarifying questions, researching existing code, and prioritizing features.
- Encourages phased implementation (P0/P1/P2) and closed-loop feedback with documentation updates.
- Clearly outlines file output, documentation standards, and permissions (read/write only for local files; no code execution).
